mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates severe labor market distress that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% for 3 months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic expansion that boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint demand signals.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * PAYEMS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return signal fails to materialize in more than 50% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: During early post-recession recovery phases, a rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals improving economic fundamentals that support equity market gains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as early recovery (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% qoq), or the return difference between early recovery and other phases is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the correlation between INDPRO trend and SPX returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers concerns about central bank tightening and real interest rate increases, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a further decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, supporting equity markets and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the return difference between declining FEDFUNDS in near-zero bound and other periods is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates central bank easing in response to labor market deterioration, which typically leads to positive equity market reactions as the policy response is seen as supportive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS decline * UNRATE rise) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return signal fails to materialize in more than 50% of interaction events.
